page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m4.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.u2a server family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and utilizes the x86_64 architecture, powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.25 GHz. The instance features 24 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory allocated per core. It does not include any local storage or integrated graphics processing units, relying entirely on network-attached storage for its disk operations.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 7 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The absence of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a tradeoff, positioning this server for workloads that depend on external block storage and do not require hardware acceleration. From a resource density perspective, the dedicated AMD EPYC cores combined with a standard memory allocation offer a balanced profile for general-purpose computing tasks. This configuration is suitable for applications such as web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, build systems, and moderate database hosting where a balanced distribution of compute and memory resources is required.
